You're in luck, your payment is marked as received and your reservation for the limited edition headphones is confirmed. Your digital receipt was sent to your registered email, michael.turner92@outlook.com.

Yes, a shipping confirmation with tracking details will be sent within 12 hours to your email and to your phone number, +1-415-773-8821. Please keep an eye on your inbox to avoid missing any updates.
